title: Pluck a column
hints: You need two type parameters: one for the object type and one for the key. The key must be one of the object's keys — that's what `keyof` is for.
Signature shape: `function pluck<T, K extends keyof T>(items: readonly T[], key: K): ???` — what is the type of `item[key]`?
The value type is `T[K]`, so return `T[K][]`: `return items.map((item) => item[key]);`
